tiktok.caption: Your brain will literally never feel rich — scientists proved it. Here's why (and the fix). 🧠💸

youtube_short.title: Why Your Brain Will NEVER Feel Rich
title_alternatives: No Matter How Much You Earn, Your Brain Resets
youtube_short.description: A Wharton study tracked 33,000 adults and found something wild — above $500K, earning more barely moves your happiness needle. That's because of something called the hedonic treadmill: every raise, every upgrade, every new normal gets absorbed by your brain within about a year. The fix isn't earning less — it's spending intentionally on experiences, not upgrades. Follow for more money psychology that actually changes how you think. #moneymindset #personalfinance #moneypsychology #financetok

hook_line: Your brain was built to never feel rich.
